_comment: Alien strain definitions. Order = type id. weak = 150% damage taken, resists = 50%. structure_dps: damage per second to walls/turrets they are blocked by; door_mult multiplies that vs blast doors. core_dps: damage to the outpost core while gnawing it. corpse_height: metres added to the corpse pile of the cell it dies in. ichor: blood colour.

aliens.name: Stalker
aliens.trait: Fast pack hunter, low HP. Arrives in floods.

aliens.name: Mauler
aliens.trait: Armoured bruiser. Smashes blast doors (x4 damage to doors).

aliens.name: Spitter
aliens.trait: Stops at range and lobs acid at structures. Fragile sac.

aliens.name: Snatcher
aliens.trait: Fast, dodges 35% of aimed shots. Abducts colonists (M4).

aliens.name: Burrower
aliens.trait: Tunnels under walls. Only Seismic hits it underground; surfaces near the core or when shaken.

aliens.name: Brood Mother
aliens.trait: Boss. Births Stalker broods every few seconds.
